parity.browser: Clean Chromium; service workers blocked; fixed UTC clock
parity.data: Synthetic fixture responses only; signed-in identity/example domains are fictional
viewports: 390x844 CSS px at device scale factor 2
parity.reproduction: Prepare the baseline and candidate Vite production outputs as <scratch-dir>/before and <scratch-dir>/after, baking the corresponding full SHA with commit-sha.txt and building with VITE_GOAL_SURFACES, VITE_WORKOS_CLIENT_ID, VITE_SENTRY_DSN and VITE_CLARITY_PROJECT_ID empty. Then run node docs/evidence/D-048-K-assistants/parity/capture.mjs <scratch-dir> <baseline-sha> <candidate-sha> from the repository root. The harness serves those existing builds, replays the synthetic API fixtures, and writes 32 captures and the exact pixel comparison to <scratch-dir>/captures.
